description: Sanitized PDI troubleshooting patterns for totalizers.

patterns.name: Possible Double Close
patterns.summary: A duplicate close can create a Grand Totalizer discontinuity and a red Skipped Close value.

match_rules.label: More than one close is confirmed
SCO activity points to an alternate GT mismatch cause

patterns.next_safe_step: Compare the previous day GT Ending, affected day GT Beginning/Ending, and review the POS upload/DRPOS information before changing any values.
patterns.why: Historical cases show that a double close can produce a distinctive GT relationship, but red Skipped Close by itself is not enough to diagnose it.
guardrails: Do not edit totalizers based only on a pattern match.
Treat totalizer correction as advanced work requiring verification of surrounding business days.
